headline.title: Meta’s new Muse Image model can pull other Instagram users into AI photos
headline.summary: Meta has introduced the Muse Image model, its first AI image generation tool developed by Superintelligence Labs, which integrates with the Meta AI app, Instagram, and WhatsApp, with plans to expand to Facebook and Messenger. This model allows users to incorporate other Instagram users into AI-generated photos.

articles.title: Why the rise of open source AI isn’t hurting Anthropic … yet
articles.summary: The article discusses how the rise of open source AI models is not negatively impacting companies like Anthropic, as both open source and proprietary models appear to serve different phases of the AI development lifecycle. It highlights the coexistence of these approaches rather than a direct competition between them.

articles.title: Microsoft joins AI cost-cutting trend by relying more on its own models
articles.summary: Microsoft is reducing its AI expenditures by increasingly utilizing its own models, aligning with a broader trend among tech companies to cut costs in AI development. This shift reflects a strategic move to enhance efficiency and control over AI resources.

articles.title: Expanding Managed Agents in Gemini API: background tasks, remote MCP and more
articles.summary: The Gemini API has introduced an expanded managed agents feature bundle, which includes support for background tasks and remote MCP functionalities. This update aims to enhance the capabilities of managed agents within the API framework.

articles.title: Shut Those Laptops! Anthropic Puts Its Claude Cowork Agent on Your Phone
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Cowork, an AI agent that continues to work on tasks even when users close their laptops, marking a shift towards smartphone-controlled AI solutions. This development is part of a broader trend in enhancing mobile accessibility for AI technologies.

articles.title: Solos debuts an even lighter version of its camera-less smart glasses
articles.summary: Solos has launched the AirGo A6, a lighter version of its smart glasses that eliminates cameras for a more streamlined design and features an AI assistant for voice interactions. The new model weighs approximately 19 grams, significantly lighter than last year's AirGo A5, which weighed between 36 to 40 grams.

articles.title: Discord admits AI moderation bug wrongfully banned users over harmless images
articles.summary: Discord acknowledged a bug in its AI moderation system that wrongfully banned users for posting harmless images, affecting accounts since May. The issue resulted in an additional 200 users being banned over the weekend before it was identified and resolved by the company.

articles.title: Anthropic is launching Claude Cowork on mobile and web
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched its Claude Cowork AI platform on mobile and web, expanding access beyond the previous desktop-only availability. Initially, the rollout will be available to Max subscribers, with plans to extend access to other Claude users in the coming weeks.

articles.title: Savi’s app aims to protect consumers from realistic AI scams like kidnappers demanding ransom
articles.summary: Savi has launched its app for iPhone and Android to help protect consumers from realistic AI scams, such as kidnappers demanding ransom. The company recently secured $7 million in seed funding to support its development.

articles.title: AI Innovators Adopt NVIDIA Vera — Why Max Single-Threaded CPU at Scale Matters
articles.summary: AI innovators are increasingly adopting NVIDIA Vera, a new category of CPUs designed for the agentic AI era, which emphasizes the importance of max single-threaded performance. These CPUs play a crucial role in the efficiency of reasoning, response time, and learning in AI systems.

articles.title: Claude Cowork expands to mobile and web
articles.summary: Claude Cowork has launched an update that allows users to initiate tasks on their desktop and receive status updates on their mobile devices. This feature enables users to access completed outputs later, even when their laptops are turned off.

articles.title: Erling Haaland Is Everywhere at the World Cup. Most of It Is AI
articles.summary: Norwegian striker Erling Haaland has transcended his role as a footballer, becoming a prominent internet character largely driven by fan engagement and artificial intelligence. The article explores how AI is amplifying his presence during the World Cup.
